purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Shikohabad

queries.query: Shikohabad Uttar Pradesh official cadastral parcel map GIS land records Bhulekh BhuNaksha
queries.result: Found first-party Uttar Pradesh Board of Revenue/UP Bhulekh and BhuNaksha services. The official digitization dashboard identifies Firozabad district and Shikohabad tehsil, but search did not expose a public parcel feature response or safe parcel geometry endpoint.

queries.query: शिकोहाबाद उत्तर प्रदेश आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा खतौनी भूमि अभिलेख
queries.result: Found the official Hindi UP Bhulekh portal and Board of Revenue page describing नक्शा/शजरा and खसरा/खतौनी services. The official Shikohabad dashboard confirms cadastral-map digitization status, but no anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was retrieved.

registryEvidence.basis: The official Uttar Pradesh Board of Revenue and UP Bhulekh pages identify the state land-record and cadastral-map services. The official dashboard specifically identifies Firozabad district, Shikohabad tehsil, district code 147 and tehsil code 00774, and reports village/mapsheet digitization status.

officialSources.observation: Official Government of Uttar Pradesh UP Bhulekh portal; describes statewide land-record access and links to plot/gata and map services.

Official Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha public viewer; current JavaScript configuration names the public service base https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver and references level, map-info, plot and GeoJSON-layer routes.
First-party Shikohabad tehsil digitization report: Firozabad/Shikohabad; 190 villages, 181 geo-reference villages, 220 mapsheets, 200 geo-reference mapsheets.
First-party unavailable-map report lists nine Shikohabad-tehsil villages with unavailable maps; this is a map-availability limitation, not citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uttar Pradesh state land-record/cadastral services, with official dashboard evidence for Firozabad district and Shikohabad tehsil.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The dashboard provides tehsil-level digitization counts and unavailable-map reporting. No city-bounded parcel feature response was retrieved, and the WUP point was not used to force a parcel lookup.

remainingUncertainty: Shikohabad is a city while the verified local service scope is the surrounding revenue tehsil/villages; the city boundary and urban cadastral coverage were not independently established. Anonymous BhuNaksha bootstrap endpoints timed out during this attempt. The evidence does not establish citywide parcel absence, and no login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe owner/address fields were used.
